Kerala Migrant Worker's Decades-Long Quest for Debt Repayment

A Kerala migrant worker has spent over three decades searching for a friend to repay a debt of Rs 1,000 borrowed in 1991. The worker, Ismail, finally found his friend and returned the amount with interest, sparking questions about the challenges faced by migrant workers in India.
